pairs.why: The two are almost the same, but B's logs and stones are a little smoother and less streaky with bark, which is closer to the soft, slightly painted finish of the real cards (the lessons show the art lead marking down texture-heavy drawings).
A has a bit more bark-grain streaking on the logs and a busier fire, while B is slightly cleaner and softer, closer to how smooth the real cards are without going plastic.
